terms.comment: Literally “things given”. Classically data are what is paid out, beside accepta, what comes in: ut pār sit ratiō acceptōrum et datōrum (Cic. Lael. 58). The sense “facts given for reasoning” is modern (Traupman 260, 300). A database is datōrum repositōrium (Traupman 260).

sources: Lewis & Short: do
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 260, 300.
